challenge_mismatch.body: The passkey response does not belong to this sign-in step.

claim_invalid.body: The agent could not prove that it received the connection.

client_data_invalid.title: Passkey response invalid
client_data_invalid.body: The browser returned an invalid passkey response.
client_data_invalid.action: Try again, or use another browser.

community_muted.body: A moderator has muted you in the community. You can still read messages.

community_no_key.body: This browser does not have the community key yet.
community_no_key.action: Wait a moment; the key arrives as soon as another user is online.

community_not_member.title: Community not joined yet
community_not_member.body: This browser has not joined the community yet.
community_not_member.action: Reload the page and try again.

counter_regressed.body: The passkey's signature counter went backwards, which can indicate a cloned authenticator.

credential_invalid.title: Passkey not accepted
credential_invalid.body: This passkey is not registered for your account.
credential_invalid.action: Use another passkey or the recovery code.

credit_exhausted.body: Paid resources are paused until the operator adds credit. Own devices with own model access keep working.
credit_exhausted.action: Ask the operator to add credit.

decrypt_failed.body: This content cannot be opened on this device.

delivery_failed.title: Prompt not delivered

epoch_stale.title: Outdated content
epoch_stale.body: This content was saved in an outdated way and was not accepted.

handover_unexpected.action: Do not confirm. Ask your AI agent to connect again.

header_invalid.title: Invalid header
header_invalid.body: A request or record header is malformed.
header_invalid.action: Reload the page and try again.

hpke_short.title: Damaged data

hub_unreachable.title: Platform unreachable
hub_unreachable.body: The execution device could not reach the platform.

id_conflict.title: Already exists

invite_unknown.title: Invitation not valid

key_revoked.title: Key revoked

key_unknown.title: Unknown key

kind_not_allowed.title: Action not allowed here

last_admin.title: Last administrator
last_admin.body: The organization needs at least one administrator.

last_passkey.title: Last passkey

limit_exceeded.title: Limit reached

log_empty.title: Membership history missing

log_fork.title: Inconsistent history

log_genesis.title: Invalid organization start
log_genesis.body: The first entry of the membership history is invalid.
log_genesis.action: If it happens again, contact support with the error code.

log_rights.title: Change without rights

log_rights.action: If it happens again, contact support with the error code.

log_rollback.title: Inconsistent history
log_rollback.body: The server presented an older membership history than before.
log_rollback.action: Do not continue in this organization and contact support with the error code.

log_signature.title: Invalid membership signature
log_signature.body: An entry of the membership history has an invalid signature.
log_signature.action: If it happens again, contact support with the error code.

log_type.title: Unknown membership entry
log_type.body: The membership history contains an unknown entry type.
log_type.action: If it happens again, contact support with the error code.

model_not_allowed.title: Model not allowed

no_changes.title: Nothing to commit

no_device.title: No execution device

no_device_available.title: No execution device available
no_device_available.body: No execution device can be assigned to this workgroup.

not_found.title: Not found

oom.title: Out of memory
oom.body: The session ran out of memory.
oom.action: Retry the task with a smaller job.

path_invalid.title: Invalid path

peer_outdated.title: A device needs an update

platform_root_mismatch.action: Open the platform under its official address and contact support.

prf_length.title: Passkey answer invalid

prf_missing.title: Passkey cannot unlock

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: Too many requests in a short time.
rate_limited.action: Wait a moment and try again.

recovery_code_length.title: Recovery code incomplete

request_invalid.body: The server refused a request that does not match the expected format.

rights_denied.title: Not permitted
rights_denied.body: The requesting person does not have the required rights.

rotation_required.title: Change not possible yet

rotation_required.action: Reload the page and try again.

rp_id_mismatch.title: Passkey for another site

runtime_exceeded.title: Time limit reached
runtime_exceeded.body: The session reached its maximum run time.

sandbox_failed.title: Sandbox failed
sandbox_failed.body: The isolated environment of the session could not be prepared.

secret_detected.title: Secret detected

seq_conflict.title: Changed meanwhile

signature_invalid.title: Invalid signature
signature_invalid.body: A signature could not be verified.

size_exceeded.title: Too large

statement_invalid.title: Sign-in statement invalid

time_skew.title: Clock out of sync

timeout.title: Timed out
timeout.body: The action did not finish in time.

tree_mismatch.title: Files changed meanwhile
tree_mismatch.action: Update from the latest state and try again.

unassigned.title: Device removed
unassigned.body: The execution device was removed from this workgroup.

unauthorized.title: Not signed in
unauthorized.body: You need to sign in for this.

unavailable.title: Service unavailable

unknown_type.title: Unknown operation

upstream_error.title: External service error

user_verification_missing.title: Verification missing
user_verification_missing.body: The authenticator did not verify you (PIN, fingerprint or face).
user_verification_missing.action: Try again and unlock your authenticator.

version_conflict.title: Changed meanwhile
version_conflict.action: Reload and apply your change again.

vm_start_failed.title: VM did not start
vm_start_failed.body: The virtual machine for this workgroup could not be started.

workvm_unavailable.body: This device cannot start a work VM right now (no slot configured, no work image, or the network boundary check failed).
workvm_unavailable.action: Try again later or ask the operator to check the device.

wrap_unauthorized.title: Unauthorized share
wrap_unauthorized.body: Something was shared by a person without the right to do so and was ignored.
